title: WhatsApp bot
subtitle: It answers your WhatsApp and books on its own. Every time it offers comes from your real schedule — it never makes a slot up.

errors.noPermission: You don't have permission to see the WhatsApp bot.
errors.planLocked: The WhatsApp bot is part of the Profesional plan. With it, your WhatsApp books appointments even while you're cutting hair.
errors.storageMissing: sql/barber_bot.sql hasn't been applied to the database yet. Until then the bot can't be turned on.
errors.aiMissing: The AI key isn't configured on the server. Without it the bot can't reply.

power.title: The bot
power.hintOn: It's answering the messages coming into your WhatsApp.
power.hintOff: Messages land in your inbox and you answer them.
power.notConnected: Connect your WhatsApp number first so the bot can reply.

tone.title: How it talks
tone.relajadoHint: Like a barber who already knows you.
tone.nameHint: Leave it empty to use the barbershop's name.
tone.notesPlaceholder: There's parking on the corner. We don't take cards. We're on the second floor.
tone.notesHint: Facts you want it to answer. Don't put prices or hours here — it takes those from your schedule.

abilities.title: What it can do
abilities.hint: Turn off whatever you'd rather handle yourself. Anything you turn off, the bot hands to a person.

hours.title: When it answers
hours.alwaysHint: Recommended: late-night messages are the ones most often lost.
hours.offHint: Outside those hours it says you'll reply when you open and flags the chat for you.
hours.noDays: Pick at least one day or the bot will never answer.

spend.title: AI spending cap
spend.hint: Per day, per barbershop. Once it hits the cap the bot stops using AI and hands chats to you, so one persistent customer can't run up the bill.
spend.reached: Today's cap has been reached. Chats are going to your inbox.

quota.title: Message allowance
quota.tight: You're running low. When it runs out the bot stops replying and we'll say so right here.
quota.exhausted: This period's allowance is gone. The bot isn't replying.

pauses.title: Chats you're handling
pauses.empty: None. The bot is handling every chat.
pauses.hint: Chats where the customer asked for a person, or the bot chose not to risk it.

history.title: What it has booked
history.empty: Nothing yet. As soon as a customer writes in, it shows up here.
history.hint: Appointments closed on their own in the chat.
